senses.gloss: m. (preced., v. P. Sm. 1284) dreamer, or interpreter of dreams.—Pl. חָלְמַיָּא, constr. חַלְמֵי.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 29:8">Targ. Jer. XXIX, 8</cite> <he>חַלְמֵי חֶלְמֵיכוֹן וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="H00967"><he>חֶלְ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01086"><he>חִילְ׳</he></cite>) your dreamers (or interpreters) whom you consult.
